def transform(grid):
    # Two fields are separated by a solid horizontal line. The output marks
    # foreground pixels of the lower field where the upper field is its background.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    upper, lower = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    upper_bg = max({v for row in upper for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in upper for x in row))
    lower_bg = max({v for row in lower for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in lower for x in row))
    lower_fg = next(v for v in {x for row in lower for x in row} if v != lower_bg)
    return [[2 if upper[r][c] == upper_bg and lower[r][c] == lower_fg else 0
             for c in range(len(grid[0]))] for r in range(len(upper))]
